title: Inverse Noise Floor Bound
statement: Let $\delta$ be a real number with $0<\delta\le \tfrac12$, and let $N=\lfloor 1/\delta\rfloor$, the greatest integer at most $1/\delta$. Then $\sqrt{1/N}\le \sqrt{3/2}\,\sqrt{\delta}$.
